name: Kyonyuu Onna Kyoushi ~Shiru Dorei no Gakuen Seikatsu~
original_name: 巨乳女教師 ～汁奴隷の学園性活～
source:
Yuji is an ordinary student. But he has a strong sex desire and wants to ejaculate all over a woman's body. Yuji keeps sexually harassing one of the most popular teachers, Mikoto persistently but he is punished by other teacher Itsuki, who is cool and dislikes men. Mikoto goes on maternity leave for a while and after she comes back, Yuji's crooked sex desire to insult Mikoto gets out of control... and schemes to give them semen training.

[From ErogeShop]
